integrity: Analytic argument with an explicitly cited published Chen--Stein approximation theorem. Finite exact checker verifies smaller instances but does not certify asymptotics or independence.
scientific_limitations: Only two synthetic outputs and independent uniform strict input rankings. The matching-bound sufficient condition does not characterize overall existence; the 3^{n/3} scale is not asserted optimal.
title: Two-scale probabilistic guarantees for pairwise-proportional ranking compression
